task: vector_addition concrete mixed integer/bool and fp16/bf16 extension
standard: all original declared stages/dtypes/branches; only explicitly registered numerical assumptions may be deferred

software_primitives: Binary16.round directly from exact integer rational
FP.round .fp32 and FP.add for bf16 mixed profiles
public_contract.carrier: FP.Value .fp32 carries low16 binary16/bfloat16 payloads and full32 binary32 values. Profile/dtype chooses decoding; carrier embedding is not numerical fp32 rounding.
public_contract.integer_conversion_ast: Profile-selected fromInt/fromNat rounds directly to target computation dtype. Explicit .real→target cast is an identity carrier-tag bridge, not a numerical conversion or native .real provenance theorem.
public_contract.unused_floating_rest: No Algebra callback occurs in the independent result formula; rest supplies unreachable operations.
public_contract.total_contract: Every logical source bit pattern and masked lane has a totalized execution. Undefined active integer conversions retain the explicitly supplied arbitrary policy.
public_contract.defined_contract: Only active integer-output addresses must have successful finite/range toward-zero conversion after the real source extension route. Under this domain every arbitrary policy gives the same specified memory.
public_contract.floating_output_contract: No integer-conversion domain condition or finiteness condition is required for fp16/bf16 output. Concrete software arithmetic covers exceptional encodings.

numerical_assumptions.detail: Own-width BitVec normalization precedes one exact-rational rounding. fp16 uses Binary16.round directly, never round-to-fp32 then narrow. bf16 mixed profiles round integer operands to fp32. Bind native rounding mode/format/representability.

Binary16.add is used for fp16 mixed profiles; FP.add for bf16 mixed profiles. Ordered operands are retained. Bind cfg, flush behavior, rounding and NaN/signaling/payload behavior; no commutativity or real exactness assumption is substituted.

bf16 input widens by exact sign/exponent/fraction embedding. Half results widen by BinaryConversion.widen before integer conversion; bf16 floating outputs narrow with FP.cast .bf16 cfg. Native widening signaling/NaN/flush behavior and narrowing must be bound. BinaryConversion.narrow is not used as a rounding operation.

toSigned/toUnsigned retains destination width, including signed8 for bool stores. Finite/range domain is explicit; undefined policy remains visible outside it. No finite/representable runtime guard was added to Python. Policy independence only constrains active integer stores.

structural_remaining.gap: 57 promoted dtype pairs have no logical value/grid proof
structural_remaining.detail: 18 mixed fp64,11 supported fp64 floating,28 semantically promoted fnuz frontend rejections. Errors and unsupported target behavior still require source-level contracts.

All36 exact-source TTIR graphs are copied with verified frozen-audit hashes. Every graph was audited through ordered loads/conversions/add/store, pointer roots, absent load other, signed i32 pid*1024+arange and mask slt n_elements. This is an SSA observation audit, not a formal extraction/compiler theorem. No new frontend/native backend/GPU runs; totalized software execution does not prove native poison propagation or absence of traps.

Low16 payload carrier views, logical Int/Nat cells, own-width normalization, bool i8 reinterpretation and exact Nat offsets need native representability and allocation/layout refinement. The i32 native offset/mask expressions are audited but their overflow/extent behavior is not proved here. Missing shape/stride/device guards were not invented; physical overlapping views with different bases/widths/strides remain open.

This batch proves the complete ascending logical grid with current-memory reads and equal logical region aliases. Instruction interleaving, allocation/empty_like/device behavior, native wrapper dispatch and Python/Torch harness execution retain prior gaps.
